question: Which of the following is one of the largest spiral galaxies?
solution:
The correct answer is __**NGC 6872**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **NGC 6872** is one of the largest spiral galaxies known to date.
 
• It is also known as the Condor Galaxy.
 
• NGC 6872 has an impressive wingspan of over 522,000 light-years, making it more than five times the size of the Milky Way.
